tool_schemas.name: list_customers
tool_schemas.description: Lists customers, returning the current customer set and applying an optional tier filter. Requests are refused when a tier filter is provided but is not one of the supported tiers for this service, because the filter cannot be applied. Requests are also refused if the tier value is missing/empty when supplied.
tool_schemas.implementation:
_DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0093000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0093000") else "/app/database")
def list_customers(tier=None):
    import json
    with open(__import__("os").path.join(_DB, 'customers.json')) as f:
        cs = json.load(f)
    if tier:
        cs = [c for c in cs if c.get('tier') == tier]
    return cs

tool_schemas.name: get_customer
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a customer by customer_id and returns the customer record when it exists; if it does not exist, the response indicates it was not found. Requests are refused when customer_id is missing or blank, because a specific customer cannot be looked up. Requests are also refused when customer_id is not a valid identifier format for this service.

tool_schemas.name: get_raw_customer
tool_schemas.description: Looks up a raw-import customer record by email and returns the raw record when it exists; if it does not exist, the response indicates it was not found. Requests are refused when email is missing or blank, because no lookup key was provided. Requests are also refused when email is not a valid email address format, because it cannot be matched reliably.

tool_schemas.name: total_mrr
tool_schemas.description: Returns aggregated monthly recurring revenue (MRR) across customers, including a per-tier breakdown; when a tier is provided, it returns the aggregate for that single tier instead of the full breakdown. Requests are refused when tier is provided but is not one of the supported values (enterprise, pro, starter), because the service cannot compute an aggregate for an unknown tier. Requests are also refused when any parameters other than tier are sent, because the endpoint does not accept additional inputs.

tier.description: Optional tier filter to aggregate MRR for a single tier only.
